scientific_integrity: The all-n quantifier is established by five exact residue-class constructions modulo 5 plus five explicit small cases. The packaged checker is a regression test and does not substitute finite sampling for the symbolic proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem resolves only the dyadic family 60*2^n. It does not classify strongly pseudoperfect numbers, their representations, or their natural density.
title: All dyadic multiples \(60\cdot 2^n\) are strongly pseudoperfect
